name: Klara 1000-case attention adaptation v1
selection_rule: First 1000 non-quarantined train and 64 validation IDs in prior audit hash order. Fresh test: one ID per group, ranked by a new fixed hash, excluding previous final-test groups.

training.initialization: Pinned pretrained CatVTON-MaskFree, not the 63-case adapter
training.trainable: Existing .attn1. parameters only; no new layers
training.sampling: Seeded shuffled full passes; every accepted training case visited once per epoch
training.loss: Standard denoising MSE, matching the earlier method
training.checkpoint_rule: Use the final planned checkpoint; no choosing a checkpoint from test results
training.timing_note: Prior 200 updates summed to 47.36 seconds. Linear projection for 3000 is about 12 minutes of updates only; not a measured new-run duration.

evaluation.policy: Evaluate matched inputs and seeds; report exclusions for every model. Do not inspect/download fresh test images before protocol and checkpoint are frozen.
evaluation.interpretation: Both data volume and update budget change versus the 63-case run. This is not an isolated causal test of dataset size.

readiness_requirements: Fetch pinned training/validation files and record hashes and source mappings.
Fully decode all images; verify dimensions and mask alignment.
Audit byte and decoded-pixel duplicates across development splits; do not claim identity-disjointness.
Inspect a predetermined contact-sheet sample and investigate technical anomalies; record review coverage honestly.
Quarantine any newly invalid cases. Do not silently replace them; freeze an amendment before training if the count changes.
Implement and CPU-test a separate bounded runner; do not modify the completed 63-case protocol.
Confirm VM availability and avoid overlapping training with studio GPU generation.
limits: Custom partitions of original official test data; not an official benchmark
Subject identity separation and upstream exposure remain unverified
No automatic live-model replacement; results must first be evaluated
